metadata.note: Two cast manifolds, one per bank (the banks alternate in the firing order 1-5-3-7-4-8-2-6); the pipe between the manifolds (part 122561) joins the banks before the turbines and is always open (the wastegate is not moved); the left and right IHI turbines' throats (their size an estimate, as the 959's), a pipe from each turbocharger into the one silencer, no catalyst; two outer outlets from the silencer. Layout from Ferrari's part list 021 (exhaust, without catalyst), as read by the stage auditor, not read here; its drawing not read. Valve: two exhaust valves per cylinder, 26 mm each (FIA form B-293, as read by the stage auditor), written as one valve of their combined area, 36.8 mm (lift taken as at least 6.5 mm); open about 280 deg, from 54 BBDC / 10 ATDC at 0.5 mm (an owner's manual as quoted on a forum, read as the Testarossa's). Pipes after the turbines 54 mm, a replacement maker's main pipe (Tubi Style, for the catalyst car); the 70 mm tips are not represented. Primary, crossover and pipe lengths and the primaries' and crossover's diameters are estimates. Silencer bodies are straight pipes of their inlet diameter; the wastegate and its centre outlet are not represented.
